$comment: The last aggregate OpenSSF Scorecard value accepted for this repository. G9 fails if a run comes back more than max_drop_from_baseline below it. Updated BY HAND, in a pull request, with the run that justifies it - never by a workflow, because a workflow that can rewrite its own baseline can ratchet itself down one run at a time.
note: null means no baseline has been recorded yet. The gate treats that as 'nothing to compare', prints it, and does not invent a pass.
